en-US: Build 191 — expedited internal device testing. Both SDK app regression suites passed 204 tests; iPad and iPhone NativeNotes components passed 101 each. Three UI automation failures remain recorded: SDK27 iPad opening a body-search result, SDK27 iPhone New-button readiness, and accepted-SDK iPhone initial assistant restart-button readiness. This candidate has not passed full UI acceptance. Test Notes content search, document covers and reopening, Pencil controls, native Office editing, and local-model chat stability. Office covers may be labelled extracted-content summaries rather than exact page layout. Also test persisted cloud-build jobs after closing and reopening the App. Use your own cloud-model credentials. Please include device, OS, model and a short reproduction in feedback.
zh-Hans: Build 191：按要求先提供内部真机测试。两个 SDK 的应用回归各通过 204 项，iPad、iPhone 手记组件各通过 101 项。三项界面自动化失败仍保留：SDK27 的 iPad 点击正文搜索结果查询超时、iPhone 新建按钮就绪检查超时，以及发布 SDK 的 iPhone 首次打开助手时重新开始按钮就绪检查超时。此候选版本尚未通过完整界面验收。请重点测试手记全文搜索、文档封面和重新打开、Pencil 工具、原生 Office 编辑及本地模型聊天稳定性。Office 封面可能是带标识的内容摘要，并非原始排版预览；也请测试云端构建期间关闭再重开 App 的任务恢复。云端模型使用自己的凭据。反馈请带设备、系统、模型及简短复现步骤。
